NewsArticle.Title: Tutorial
NewsArticle.Content: Mundanes have heard the plight of uneducated Aislings. Volunteer mundanes dedicate their lives and property to a six stage, detailed and interactive tutorial, covering everything from moving around, client features, interacting, combat, social features, and an introduction to Temuairan society. Completing the tutorial gives the new Aisling a few thousand experience points, unique magic items, basic items, and several coins. Mundanes ask Demagogues or greater to post their wisdom to a new Aisling on the bulletin board in the Tutorial. The tutorial is available now for testing and sneak preview by Respected Citizens or greater. Ask Riona in Mileth Inn. Give a young one the best impression. [Let us know](http://www.darkages.com/contact/index.html) if we missed something. See [all features.](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html)
